about: U13a: Magma cells that redefine names, run in page order. Each case's cells, run top to bottom as one Magma 2.18 session (magma -b < the cells joined, made by scripts/magma-page-order-oracle.py), give `out`; the reactive notebook's page-order renames (src/rename.ts, src/magma.ts PAGE_ORDER) must give the same, each cell its own translation (test/magma-page-order.test.ts).

cases.name: an op-assignment reads the earlier value
a func takes x when it is made
a procedure's reference argument
cells: procedure P(~a) a +:= 5; end procedure; P(~x);

cases.name: a function reads a global defined later, at its call
cells: g := function(y) return c + y; end function;

cases.name: a definition in a block keeps the earlier value when it doesn't run
cells: if false then x := 5; end if; print x;

cases.name: a loop's variable is no definition
cells: for i in [1..2] do j := i; end for;
